definitions.short: stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant
definitions.full: H890. boshah בָּאְשָׁה noun feminine (stinking things) stinking or noxious weeds , Job 31:40 בָאְשָׁה שְׂעֹרָה וְתַחַתֿ חוֺחַ יֵצֵא חִטָּה תַּחַת instead of wheat may there spring forth bramble, and instead of barley stinking weeds (compare Assyrian bîšu Zehnpf BAS i. 633 ).
